title: Paper + Codex + Storybook
outcome: Design in Paper, keep the component library in sync via MCP, and ship Storybook components agents can reuse.
summary: Marvin Kennis's production loop: Paper + Codex closes the design-to-production gap, with Storybook as the shared component surface. A follow-up notes Paper Desktop + MCP + Codex as the setup.

blocks.role: Keeps Paper in sync with the component library.
Makes the components usable by other engineers and agents.

source.quote: Design in Paper. MCP to keep it in sync with our component library. Storybook components now usable by other engineers + agents.
